input.summary: Shoot the right in-line drops through 3x Bonus, complete the upper 1-2-3 bank for 4x, then complete the lower-left bank for 5x and both lit spinners.

steps.text: Time the plunge so the ball hits the lit upper 1-2-3 target, then control the upper-playfield exit.
From the left flipper, clear the three right in-line drops. The second lights 2x Bonus, and the third lights 3x Bonus.
modeNotes: If Extra Ball is enabled, hit the standup behind the bank after the third drop. On competition or novelty settings, that award scores 25,000 instead.
Check whether Bonus X and the 2x/3x playfield lamps carry between balls, and whether Extra Ball is enabled or scores 25,000.

steps.text: With 3x lit, complete the upper 1-2-3 bank to light 4x Bonus.
With 4x lit, complete the lower-left bank to light 5x Bonus and the left spinner.
Complete the lower-left bank a second time to light the right spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Repeat the safer lit spinner. From its upper-playfield return, shoot the upper 1-2-3 bank and rollovers.

input.overview: Bonus X comes from the right in-line, upper 1-2-3, and lower-left banks in that order. Hit each upper 1-2-3 target while its arrow flashes to light 2x playfield scoring, and light all eight lower-playfield colors to light 3x. When both lamps are lit, shoot the center saucer for a timed 5x playfield window.

fallback.title: Simpler Bonus X route
fallback.when: Use this shorter route when you want fewer features to track.

steps.text: Shoot the right in-line drops through 3x Bonus.
Complete the upper 1-2-3 bank for 4x, then the lower-left bank for 5x.
Shoot a spinner ramp back to the upper playfield and keep scoring there while protecting the built Bonus.

alternatives.title: Combined 5x playfield
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the center saucer and at least one lit spinner return safely.

steps.text: Hit each upper 1-2-3 drop while its arrow flashes. This qualifies 2x playfield at the center saucer.
Hit the four lower-left drops and both right standups, then roll through both inlanes to light all eight lower-playfield colors and qualify 3x playfield at the center saucer.
While both 2x and 3x playfield are lit, shoot the center saucer to start 15 seconds of 5x playfield scoring.
modeNotes: Starting 5x uses both lit playfield-multiplier awards; neither can be started again on that ball.

steps.text: During 5x, shoot a lit 1,000-per-spin spinner. If upper Bonus is ready, hit the lit top-center standup; to collect lower Bonus, lower the single upper drop target and send the ball through the shooter lane.
Hit upper targets and rollovers to raise upper Bonus. Hit the lower-left drops, first right in-line drop, lit right standups, and lit inlanes to raise lower Bonus. Each stops at 19,000.
Hit the second and third right in-line drops, then complete the upper 1-2-3 bank and lower-left bank in that order to reach 5x Bonus.
Hit each upper 1-2-3 drop while its arrow flashes to light 2x playfield. Hit the four lower-left drops and both right standups, then roll through both inlanes to light 3x playfield.
With both playfield-multiplier lamps lit, shoot the center saucer to start 15 seconds of 5x playfield scoring, then shoot a lit spinner or make a ready Bonus collect.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand the right spinner from the right flipper. Lower the upper flipper after the shot so it does not block the lane or return.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Use one small forward nudge to move away from the down ramp. Use a second small nudge to send the ball across the saucer feed to the upper flipper.

techniques.name: Post pass
techniques.instruction: Push a trapped ball against the sling post and let it cross to the flipper that shoots the inline drops.

techniques.name: Alley-pass return-lane collect
techniques.instruction: Let the ball reach the flipper base. Make one full flip across the opposite inlane to collect a needed color.

cautions.issue: Drop targets and short spinner shots can return through the center.
cautions.response: After the ball contacts the target, lower the shooting flipper. Do not make a second reflex flip at the rebound.

cautions.issue: A large nudge can forfeit both built bonuses with a tilt.
cautions.response: Use small upper-playfield nudges. Do not make a late desperation move after the ball reaches the lower playfield.

cautions.issue: A drop target can fail to fall or register.
cautions.response: Watch the first bank completion. Call the tournament director if a required target does not score correctly.

steps.title: Reach 3x Bonus X
steps.text: From the left flipper, clear the three right in-line drops. The second drop lights 2x Bonus, and the third lights 3x Bonus.

steps.title: Use the lit spinners
steps.text: Complete the lower-left bank again to light the right spinner for 1,000 per spin. Repeat the safer lit spinner and use its return to reach the upper bank and rollovers.
